strategies.name: vwap_break_and_pullback_long
strategies.entry_summary: Only on high-volume, lower-float penny stocks, wait for a stock that opened weak below VWAP to break back above VWAP with strong volume and obvious bullish momentum. Enter long on the subsequent pullback/retest of VWAP or a nearby key level as support, looking for the bounce.
strategies.exit_summary: Manage as a scalp by selling into the bounce after VWAP holds and price pushes back up; the transcript does not give a precise stop/target formula, but the taught management is to use VWAP as the support thesis and avoid long entries when VWAP remains overhead as resistance.
